practiceDocument: Create an isolated decorative illustration on a genuinely transparent background for an adult classroom garden dashboard. A small elegant stack of warm ivory paper sheets tilted clockwise about 10 degrees, viewed nearly front-on with slight dimensional thickness and soft shadow. Top page contains a rectangular colourful photograph-like illustration of one pink coneflower with dark orange centre against blue sky, green leaves and a white cloud. Below image exactly three simple muted taupe horizontal lines representing text, no readable letters. A few realistic green leafy sprigs peek from behind paper at lower left and upper right and lower right, balanced but restrained. Polished semi-realistic 2.5D farm-game rendering, natural paper texture, warm sunlight upper right, matching rich botanical illustration of the supplied style. Entire object including leaves and shadow fully intact, generous transparent margin on every side. No surrounding card, no UI, no headings, no digits, no actual text, no watermark, no frame, no backdrop, no checkerboard painted in. Portrait composition. Asset will sit on a pale peach card next to live editable text saying Add a flower photo to the flyer. Do not render that text.
progression:
Use case ui-mockup. Use the supplied approved garden concept as the art direction. Produce ONE landscape presentation image with THREE equally sized panels side by side showing the same 2.5D farm garden at three successive growth stages. This is a progression study, not three independent gardens in gameplay. Semi-realistic illustrated materials, dimensional wooden raised beds, sunny sky, white clouds, picket fence, fruit tree, palm, bird, butterfly, bee, teal watering can. Restrained ornamental greenery, rich visible soil, inviting room to grow. No mature decorative flowers in beds or borders. In EVERY panel the same shared bed contains exactly ONE active plant in the same soil position; all other planting spots empty. No learner fruit markers (shared plants cannot be attributed to individual learners). Include a small empty foreground mastery strip integrated into the garden. Preserve art style of reference, simplify enough to read the plant changes. 
Panel 1 heading "Seed", one tiny visible seed nestled in a soil mound, text below "4 / 24 stars".
Panel 2 heading "Sprout", same position with a young two-leaf sprout, text below "8 / 24 stars".
Panel 3 heading "Leafy", same position with a taller stem and several lush leaves, no flowers or buds, text below "16 / 24 stars".
Across top one title "Our Class Garden". Across bottom a restrained diagram "Seed → Sprout → Leafy → Flower" with simple little botanical icons, clearly separate from the scene. No right sidebar or accuracy card on this comparison sheet. Show the plant visibly growing taller while the scene, sun, weather, camera, bed sizes and framing remain identical. Each panel clean and spacious with large navy readable type. Important actual game rule: eight present learners require 24 shared stars per new flower; under 8 seeded, 8 to 15 sprout, 16 to 23 leafy, 24 bloom. Do not show all stages planted simultaneously in one garden. No slogans, watermarks or browser chrome.
background:
Generate a reusable GAME BACKGROUND asset, no UI or text anywhere. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. Match the supplied garden art direction: semi-realistic beautiful 2.5D farm illustration, slightly elevated orthographic camera, warm sunlight upper right, pale blue sky top quarter, two puffy clouds and sun, restrained distant hills, rounded apple tree rear left, green climbing trellis rear centre, small palm rear right, short cream picket fences, a perched bird, butterfly and small bee, teal watering can lower right. Keep environment welcoming, green and simple. NO FLOWERS OR PLANTS INSIDE ANY BEDS, NO FRUIT IDENTITY MARKERS, NO SIGNS, NO WORDS, NO NUMBERS, NO UI. This must support plants layered on top by code.
Composition precision: exactly THREE empty wooden raised beds with rich clean dark soil, arranged as reference: ONE wide back bed centred at x=55%, soil extending from x=33% to 76%, y=40% to 55%; TWO front beds, left soil x=4% to 43%, y=62% to 76%, right soil x=62% to 96%, y=62% to 76%. Wood front faces below soil, natural timber texture and metal corner bolts. Clear soil space without grass, stones, sprouts or flowers inside. Curved stone path between beds. At bottom left add a LOW narrow empty soil strip for mastery flowers from x=5% to 80%, soil y=88% to 94%, modest wood edge below it. This strip must be empty. All four soil areas fully visible with room above for layered plants. Do not place foreground foliage over soil. Very few decorative flowers outside beds, preferably none; beauty comes from green foliage, rich textures, light, composition. No dense flower borders. Background is a clean reusable opaque scene plate, NOT a mockup screenshot. Realistic rendering balanced with simple readable 2.5D farm-game geometry.
sharedStages: Create a production GAME SPRITE ATLAS on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Wide landscape canvas divided invisibly into THREE EQUAL WIDTH COLUMNS, one sprite per column, nothing else. No visible grid, no labels, no text, no scenery, no pots. Semi-realistic richly rendered 2.5D botanical assets with warm sun from upper right, consistent with a realistic illustrated farm game. Left column: one small golden brown seed resting in a small rich soil mound. Middle column: one short vivid green sprout with exactly two cotyledon leaves and a delicate stem rooted in an identical small soil mound. Right column: one taller healthy leafy green plant with six leaves and a central stem, no bud or flower, rooted in an identical small soil mound. Exactly three isolated sprites. Each centred precisely horizontally within its equal third of the canvas at x=16.667%,50%,83.333%. All soil BASELINES exactly at y=88% canvas height, same soil mound footprint width 16% of whole canvas. Seed total height 12% of canvas, sprout total height 32%, leafy plant total height 68%. Leafy plant top at y=20%. Every part fully inside its column with generous transparent padding, no clipping or overlap. Clean anti-aliased edges with natural leaf tips and fine stems, dimensional leaf veins, soft shadows only beneath each mound. Do not draw checkerboard: alpha channel transparency. This asset will be shown by CSS background-position with three equal frames, so cell alignment and common ground baseline are critical.
leafyKinds:
Production botanical GAME SPRITE ATLAS on genuinely transparent alpha background. Canvas landscape 4:3 ratio, arranged EXACTLY FOUR equal columns by THREE equal rows = TWELVE separate juvenile LEAFY plant sprites. Invisible uniform square grid. Each plant entirely contained in its cell with transparent padding, centred horizontally, soil base at 90% of its cell height. All fully intact. No labels, text, borders, gridlines, checkerboard, pots, flowers, buds, fruit, insects, scenery or extras. Realistic illustrated 2.5D farm-game assets, slightly elevated camera, warm sun upper right, rich green dimensional leaves with subtle veins, tiny rich brown soil mound under each plant, consistent scale. Each plant about 65% of its cell height. Clearly distinguish species by correct foliage and growth habit. Exact order left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
ROW 1: 1 sunflower juvenile plant with broad heart-shaped serrated leaves on upright stem; 2 tomato juvenile plant with branching compound jagged lobed leaflets; 3 lotus juvenile plant with three round shield-shaped leaves on slender petioles from small wet mud mound, no water background; 4 apricot juvenile sapling with small oval finely serrated leaves on woody stem.
ROW 2: 5 rose juvenile plant with compound serrated leaflets on short woody thorny branches; 6 tulip juvenile plant with upright broad smooth strap-like leaves emerging from base, no stem above leaves; 7 chilli juvenile plant with smooth pointed glossy ovate leaves on branching green stems; 8 lavender juvenile plant with thin silvery grey-green narrow leaves on several upright stems, NO purple flowers.
ROW 3: 9 hibiscus juvenile plant with broad glossy ovate serrated leaves; 10 orchid juvenile plant with four thick fleshy elongated broad leaves in a basal rosette, small mossy soil mound, no flower stalk; 11 peach juvenile sapling with long narrow lance-shaped serrated leaves on slender woody stem; 12 marigold juvenile plant with finely divided pinnate toothed leaflets, dense small bush.
All twelve plants at leafy stage only. Consistent common ground baseline in each equal square cell critical for CSS/SVG sprite rendering. Individual silhouettes visibly different, natural organic asymmetry. Fine clean edges and absolutely transparent background.
matureKinds:
Create a matching MATURE / FLOWERING plant atlas for the provided juvenile leafy atlas. Production 2.5D semi-realistic illustrated farm game cutout sprites, genuine transparent background. Same arrangement: EXACTLY 4 columns × 3 rows, invisible square cells, each plant centred inside its cell, base of soil mound at 94% cell height, top above 10%, no clipping or overlap. Keep every leaf and petal inside its cell with clear transparent gutters. No labels, no text, no checkerboard, no visible grid, no background, no pots. Warm lighting upper right, rich natural leaf textures, readable botanical silhouettes, fine smooth clean edges. Mature versions with leaves and flowers/fruits that match species. EXACT row-major order:
ROW1 sunflower (one golden sunflower with broad leaves), tomato (branching compound leaves and red tomatoes), lotus (pink lotus bloom with round leaves on slender stalks), apricot blossom (small twig with yellow five-petal blossoms, Vietnamese hoa mai visual convention matching game's yellow apricot).
ROW2 rose (red rose flowers, compound serrated leaves), tulip (red tulip flower above smooth strap leaves), chilli (slender red chilli peppers with pointed leaves), lavender (purple flower spikes above narrow silver-green leaves).
ROW3 hibiscus (pink hibiscus flower with projecting central stamen, broad leaves), orchid (purple orchid flowers on arching stem, thick broad basal leaves), peach blossom (pink five-petal blossoms on small woody branch with narrow leaves), marigold (orange pompom blooms above pinnate foliage).
Small soil mound at base of each. Consistent illustrated realism and 2.5D orientation matching reference. All twelve fully intact. Transparent background alpha.
